entries: At last {first} {ACT_PERSON:gentle} {SOMEONE:!threatening} and {ACT_PLACE:mundane} {landmark}, and the station hummed again.
{first} and {SOMEONE:!threatening} {ACT_THING} {THING} together {MANNER}, under a sky they had made.
{first} left {VICE} behind in {landmark}, and the hull stopped singing.
{place} kept its course, and {first} {HABIT_PERSON} {CLOSE:human} across the light-years.
{first} gave {landmark} over to the {rival}, and the long quiet returned {MANNER}.
